verification_targets.notes: Absolute coordinate measured from global Z = 0. Do NOT report 52 (height above base). Vertical leg top face is at Z = +60.

verification_targets.description: The finished L-bracket (base plate + vertical leg with two through-holes) must be exactly one connected solid; the vertical leg must be fused to the base plate with no gaps, overlapping shells or separate lumps.

verification_targets.description: The final solid must be a closed, watertight manifold shell (all edges shared by exactly two faces, zero free or non-manifold edges) so it is a valid 3D-printable STL.

functional_requirements: Two M6 clearance through-holes (6.0 mm diameter) in the horizontal base plate for fastening the bracket down to a flat surface; fastener spacing 50 mm centre-to-centre (2 x HOLE_CENTER_X).

Bracket must sit flat: the underside of the base plate is a single planar face at Z = 0 providing full contact for mounting.
Vertical leg provides a flat mounting face (front face at Y = +12) for an accessory panel or vertical member.
Symmetric left-right (mirror about the YZ plane) so the part is orientation-independent during assembly.
Part to be 3D-printable in a single piece without support material on the mounting faces (print flat on base plate, Z up).
Two mounting holes at 15 mm from each end give 12 mm of material between the hole edge and the plate end for adequate bearing and print strength.
special_features: The L-profile MUST consist of exactly two perpendicular legs of uniform THICKNESS = 8 mm: a horizontal base plate spanning X from -OVERALL_WIDTH_X/2 to +OVERALL_WIDTH_X/2, Y from -BASE_DEPTH_Y/2 to +BASE_DEPTH_Y/2, and Z from 0 to THICKNESS; plus a vertical leg spanning Y = VERTICAL_WALL_Y_MIN (+12) to VERTICAL_WALL_Y_MAX (+20), X from -OVERALL_WIDTH_X/2 to +OVERALL_WIDTH_X/2, and Z from 0 to OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z (60).
The vertical leg MUST be positioned at the REAR of the base plate (Y from +12 to +20), flush with the base rear face at Y = +BASE_DEPTH_Y/2; it MUST NOT be centred in Y and MUST NOT straddle Y = 0.

OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z (60 mm) MUST be the absolute Z extent measured from the base bottom plane Z = 0 through the top of the vertical leg; the 60 mm INCLUDES the THICKNESS of the base plate (the leg only projects 52 mm above the base top face) — MUST NOT build the vertical leg 60 mm tall on top of the 8 mm base for a 68 mm total.

The two 6 mm through-holes MUST be centred at X = ±HOLE_CENTER_X (= ±25, which is HOLE_OFFSET_FROM_END = 15 mm from each 80 mm end) and at Y = HOLE_CENTER_Y = 0 (mid-depth of the base plate); hole spacing along the long arm MUST be 50 mm.

The through-holes MUST be drilled along the Z axis (Cylinder axis = Z, height greater than THICKNESS, subtractive) so they open through both the top and bottom faces of the base plate; MUST NOT be oriented along X or Y.
All features MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X = 0): the hole pair mirrors about X = 0 and the leg extents are equal in +X and -X.

Through-holes MUST NOT intersect the vertical leg or the outer edges: the hole edge at Y = ±3 must stay at least 5 mm from the vertical leg front face at Y = +12 (actual clearance 9 mm), and the hole edge at X = ±28 must stay at least 5 mm from the plate ends at X = ±40 (actual clearance 12 mm).

The inner corner of the L (junction of base top face Z = 8 and vertical leg front face Y = +12) MUST be a sharp 90 degree corner with no fillet or chamfer, and the outer faces MUST be planar, so the bounding box remains exactly 80 x 40 x 60 mm.
The base plate and vertical leg MUST be fused into ONE solid before the hole subtraction; the model MUST NOT be exported as two separate bodies or as a hollow/lofted shell.

sketches.notes: Base plate footprint centered on XY origin: X = -40..+40, Y = -20..+20 (80 x 40). Extruded +Z by THICKNESS = 8 to give base Z = 0..8.

Custom profile (non-regular quadrilateral, NOT a RegularPolygon): vertical leg footprint in the world-XY plane, X = -40..+40, Y = +12..+20 (8 mm thick in Y). Rear face at Y = +20 is flush with the base rear face at Y = +BASE_DEPTH_Y/2 = 20; leg is at the REAR, it does not straddle Y = 0 and is not centred in Y. Extruded from Z = 0 up to Z = 60 so the sketched footprint overlaps the base plate volume (Z = 0..8) for a valid union; the leg therefore projects only 60 - 8 = 52 mm above the base top face.

steps.label: Extrude horizontal base plate 80 x 40 x 8
steps.notes: Plane.XY, extrusion +Z by THICKNESS = 8. Resulting base plate: X -40..+40, Y -20..+20, Z 0..8. Bottom face at Z = 0 is the single planar mounting face.

steps.label: Extrude rear vertical leg 80 x 8 x 60
